title: DeepSeek R1 and open reasoning models
summary: Open-weight reasoning models that made frontier-adjacent capability downloadable.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

DeepSeek released R1 in January 2025 under an MIT licence, with reasoning traces and distilled variants that could be run or fine-tuned locally. Its companion V3 model used a mixture-of-experts design with 671bn total parameters and about 37bn active per token. The published training figures — roughly 2.8m H800 GPU-hours — reframed the cost debate, although they exclude earlier research and data work.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Early commercial
Estimated window 2025–2027
Confidence label Confident
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

If a model of this class is free to download, the durable value moves to distribution, proprietary data, and the compute that serves it.

What Would Change The View

  • Whether distilled models retain reliability in production.
  • Enterprise willingness to self-host versus buy.
  • Export-control effects on future training runs.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
